capabilities.title: Switchable
capabilities.description: Boolean control state: true means on and false means off; this is not device availability. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

is_on.title: On state
is_on.description: Boolean control state: true means on and false means off; this is not device availability.

set_on.title: Set on state
set_on.description: Declare an absolute target; completion requires eligible observed State agreement, not provider ACK. No execution is implemented by this descriptor.

capabilities.title: Positionable
capabilities.description: Absolute opening percent as an integer: 0 means fully closed, 100 means fully open; inclusive range 0–100 with no tolerance or rounding. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

position_percent.title: Opening position
position_percent.description: Absolute opening percent as an integer: 0 means fully closed, 100 means fully open; inclusive range 0–100 with no tolerance or rounding.

set_position.title: Set absolute opening position
set_position.description: Declare an absolute target; completion requires eligible observed State agreement, not provider ACK. No execution is implemented by this descriptor.

capabilities.title: TemperatureSensor
capabilities.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius; minimum -273.15 (absolute zero), with no generic upper bound. Known finite values only. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

temperature_c.title: Temperature
temperature_c.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius; minimum -273.15 (absolute zero), with no generic upper bound. Known finite values only.

capabilities.title: HumiditySensor
capabilities.description: Relative humidity in percent, inclusive range 0–100; fractional values are allowed. Known finite values only. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

relative_humidity_percent.title: Relative humidity
relative_humidity_percent.description: Relative humidity in percent, inclusive range 0–100; fractional values are allowed. Known finite values only.

capabilities.title: PowerMeter
capabilities.description: Instantaneous active power in watts: positive means consumption/import and negative means generation/export. Zero is an observed zero; signed finite values have no generic magnitude bound. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

power_w.title: Active power
power_w.description: Instantaneous active power in watts: positive means consumption/import and negative means generation/export. Zero is an observed zero; signed finite values have no generic magnitude bound.

capabilities.title: BatteryPowered
capabilities.description: Reported remaining charge in percent, inclusive range 0–100; fractional values are allowed. No charging, health or remaining-runtime inference. Revision 1 of the canonical household capability; availability is separate State metadata.

battery_percent.title: Remaining charge
battery_percent.description: Reported remaining charge in percent, inclusive range 0–100; fractional values are allowed. No charging, health or remaining-runtime inference.
